cardEffects:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your yellow Tamers as if that card is a level 3 yellow Digimon.
[When Digivolving] If [KendoGarurumon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards or you have a black or purple Digimon or Tamer, this Digimon may digivolve into [AncientGarurumon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring its digivolution requirements. If digivolved by this effect, delete this Digimon at the end of the turn.
inheritedEffect: [When Attacking] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
name: Lobomon

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT17-022 (2024/09/20, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: No, [Koji Minamoto] digivolves as a Tamer.
rulings.question: Does this card's "[Koji Minamoto]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement mean that [Koji Minamoto] is treated as a Digimon when it digivolves?

rulings.answer: No, they don’t trigger.  "When a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger when a Tamer digivolves.
rulings.question: Does this card's "[Koji Minamoto]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement to digivolve, do "when a Digimon digivolves" effects trigger?

rulings.answer: No, they don’t trigger.  "When a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger when a Tamer digivolves.
rulings.question: Does this card's "[Koji Minamoto]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement to digivolve, do "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects trigger?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  Because you're digivolving from a Tamer, it isn't considered an unsuspended Digimon.
rulings.question: My opponent activates EX3-053 [Metallicdramon]'s [On Play] effect. Can I digivolve an unsuspended [Koji Minamoto] using this card's "[Koji Minamoto]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement in the next turn?

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  P-104 [Mental Training]'s ＜Delay＞ effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.
rulings.question: Can I activate P-104 [Mental Training]'s ＜Delay＞ effect and digivolve using this card's "[Takuya Kanbara]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement in the next turn?

rulings.answer: Digimon carry over effects after digivolving or de-digivolving, therefore it's deleted at the end of the turn.
rulings.question: If I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into [AncientGarurumon], then it digivolves or is affected by ＜De-Digivolve＞, what happens to the "delete this Digimon at the end of this turn" effect?

rulings.answer: No, it isn't deleted because it's no longer considered a Digimon.
rulings.question: This Digimon has a Tamer card in its digivolution cards, and I used its [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into [AncientGarurumon], then it was affected by a ＜De-Digivolve＞ effect and became a Tamer. Does the "delete this Digimon at the end of this turn" effect delete this Tamer at such times?

rulings.answer: Digimon carry over effects after digivolving, therefore it plays [AncientGarurumon].
rulings.question: I used BT3-109 [Back for Revenge!] on this Digimon, then I used this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into [AncientGarurumon]. After this Digimon is deleted at the end of this turn, does BT3-109 [Back for Revenge!]'s effect play this card or [AncientGarurumon] into the battle area?

rulings.answer: No, it is not deleted. Effects that are processed when a specific timing is reached are processed as triggered when the timing is reached. If the Digivolved by this card's effect at the end of the turn, the "Delete this Digimon at the end of this turn" of this card is not processed because the timing to be at the end of the turn has passed.
rulings.question: I have a situation where I have my "BT17-023 KendoGarurumon" with "BT18-088 Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto" as its digivolution card. At the End of Turn, I attacked with the [When Attacking] effect of "BT18-088 Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto" and "BT17-023 Galummon" evolved into this card with the [When Attacking] effect of "BT17-023 Galummon". At this time, if this card's [When Digivolving] effect evolved into "Ancient Garurumon", will that "Ancient Garurumon" be deleted by this card's effect, although the timing of the end of turn has already passed?
